name: 84319 · Hyrum, UT
findings: ZIP 84319 (Hyrum) has 10 nonprofit organizations. 4 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
75% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
